scripts.dev:docs: pnpm build:packages && pnpm docs:generate && pnpm --filter @eonui/docs dev
scripts.dev:storybook: pnpm build:packages && pnpm docs:generate && pnpm --filter @eonui/storybook dev
scripts.dev:playground: pnpm build:packages && pnpm docs:generate && pnpm --filter @eonui/playground dev
scripts.test:contracts: pnpm --filter @eonui/manifest exec vitest run src/schema.test.ts && pnpm --filter @eonui/core exec vitest run src/manifest/registry.test.ts
scripts.test:quality: pnpm test:a11y && pnpm test:contracts && pnpm --filter @eonui/playground test
scripts.verify: pnpm build:packages && pnpm docs:generate && pnpm test:quality && pnpm typecheck
